newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Treasury refuses offers at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Treasury refuses offers at weekly auction.

text.p: Morocco's Treasury raised no funds from its weekly treasury bill auction, Bank al-Maghrib (central bank) said on Thursday.

Moroccan banks offered a total 700 million dirhams at interest rates of between 7.90 percent and 10.25 percent on a period varying from 26 weeks to 15 years "but the Treasury turned down the offers," a Moroccan official said. He gave no other details.
According to a Casablanca-based market analyst "the Treasury move was aimed at pushing local banks to lower their interest rates, considered as too high."
Treasury officials were not immediately available for comment.
Next auction was set for June 9.
